origin: Original landing room built by Muse (AI assistant) on 19 November 2026 at Steven Powell's direction, from his proposal in the Everyday Cool ideas side chat: create a 'Stem Room' and move Chemistry, Physics, Electronics, and Radio into it behind one card on the main hub — extended at his word to all six science workshops: 'Build it — Body and Measure go in too.' The room is a room-of-rooms: a banner, a short framing introduction, six cards reusing each workshop's existing hub blurb (hook, description, starter) and linking to its existing page, a short section on how the six connect, and a Help menu with in-page documentation. The six workshops themselves were not moved, renamed, or edited — their folders, files, and URLs are exactly as before, so every cross-link keeps working; their catalog entries gained a 'hubParent' marker and the hub generator (tools/build-hub.py) skips marked entries when laying out the main hub, leaving this room's single card immediately after Nerd Heaven with the 'Science' topic tag. This room's catalog description names all six workshops so the collection checker's every-title-on-the-hub rule still holds. The banner is AI-generated watercolor: the robot at a long lab bench with a chemistry flask, a circuit board, a plain billiard ball, a brass balance scale with weights, a small anatomy chart (plain silhouette), and a wooden-cabinet radio — the prompt forbade lettering and the first generation shipped text-free. It enters the catalog under 'Science' as the twenty-fourth entry, positioned immediately after Nerd Heaven. This folder is the maintained original.
